description: Sum of Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3 (selected) for the reporting period.
decision_support_purpose: Establishes the baseline magnitude a mine is managing against.

description: Direct emissions from diesel combustion and fugitive methane.
decision_support_purpose: Identifies how much of the footprint is under the mine's direct operational control.
Identifies exposure to grid carbon intensity and renewable-procurement opportunity.

description: Selected indirect emissions from transport and commuting.
decision_support_purpose: Flags indirect/logistics-related reduction opportunities outside direct operations.

description: Total emissions per tonne of coal produced.
decision_support_purpose: Enables fair comparison across mines of different scale; tracks decoupling of production from emissions.

description: Investment required per tonne of CO2e avoided in a given intervention package.
Whether the optimizer found a feasible package meeting the stated reduction target within budget.
decision_support_purpose: Answers the central decision question: can this target be met with this budget.

description: Fraction of purchased electricity sourced from renewables.
decision_support_purpose: Tracks progress on the largest lever available for Scope 2 reduction.

description: Emissions remaining after a selected intervention package is applied.
decision_support_purpose: Shows what is left to address in the next planning cycle.
